'''Carl''' (Japanese: '''カール''' ''Carl'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY051|When Light and Dark Collide!]]''. He is the director of a theater located somewhere between [[Shalour City]] and [[Coumarine City]], which organizes "Super Pokémon Battle Shows".

Carl used to be a coach of {{type|Fighting}} Pokémon. He coached his Dark {{p|Hawlucha}} in many tournaments, and eventually got it to win the [[Kalos]] [[region]] {{type|Fighting}} Pokémon tournament. However, in one of those tournaments Dark Hawlucha got injured, and wasn't able to compete anymore. Carl came up with the Super Pokémon Battle Shows, which were much less physically demanding than [[Pokémon battle]]s, and in the process switched careers for himself as well.

After hearing some cries, {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} accidentally interrupted his rehearsal of a Super Pokémon Battle Show, which they mistook for an incident between Dark Hawlucha and {{p|Snubbull}}. Carl's Gallade suffered an injured leg in the process, making it unable to perform in the next battle show. {{an|Bonnie}} proposed he use another Pokémon in Gallade's place, and it was decided [[Ash's Hawlucha]] would take this role. However the two Hawlucha failed to get along, and they instead formed a rivalry. Carl later explained Dark Hawlucha's backstory to Ash and his friends, leading Ash's Hawlucha to rethink his actions. That evening, the Super Pokémon Battle Show still went underway as planned. Although Carl panicked at first when the Hawlucha didn't act as the script told them to, he soon noticed that the audience loved the phyisical confrontation between the two, and also noticed how Ash's Hawlucha managed to give Dark Hawlucha his fighting spirit back. The Super Pokémon Battle Show proved to be a success, and the next day Carl thanked Ash and his friends and said his farewells as he traveled onto the next town for the next show.

|desc={{p|Hawlucha}}, or "'''Dark Hawlucha'''" as he was called because of his {{Shiny}} coloration, used to compete in many {{type|Fighting}} Pokémon tournaments, with Carl as his coach. He eventually managed to win the [[Kalos]] [[region]] Fighting-type Pokémon tournament. During one of those tournaments however, he got injured. He wasn't able to compete in tournaments anymore and lost his will to fight, and as such Carl came up with "Super Pokémon Battle Shows", which is much less physically demanding than a Pokémon battle.

Following Dark Hawlucha's switch to acting, he performed the role of evil villain, "Dark", in one of Carl's Super Pokémon Battle Shows. He first appeared rehearsing this role with {{p|Snubbull}}, which {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} mistook as Hawlucha actually attacking Snubbull. In the process, Dark Hawlucha's fellow actor {{p|Gallade}} was hurt, and it was later revealed he had to heal several days, as such not being able to perform in the next Super Pokémon Battle Show.

It was decided that [[Ash's Hawlucha]] would take Gallade's place. However, the cooperation between both Hawlucha didn't go smoothly, as Ash's Hawlucha refused to lose, even if it was only acting instead of actually battling. This angered Dark Hawlucha, who angrily walked off the set after a physical confrontation between the two. He went to a tree, where he started to train itself.

As the Super Pokémon Battle Show got underway that evening, {{TRT}} attacked. Dark Hawlucha and Ash's Hawlucha teamed up to defeat Team Rocket, and later settled their differences with a handshake. As the play continued, Ash's Hawlucha accidentally tripped on a prop, but Dark Hawlucha helped him get up. In a final showdown, they again confronted each other, quickly exchanging Karate Chops. Although this was not in the script, the audience started to cheer them on. During this battle, Carl noticed that Dark Hawlucha's expression had changed, and he had regained his former fighting spirit. Dark Hawlucha was eventually worn out, but this time Ash's Hawlucha helped him to get up, and they now fully respected each other. The next day, he was present to say his goodbyes to Ash, his friends, and Ash's Hawlucha.

Dark Hawlucha's only known move is {{m|Karate Chop}}.}}
